en.headline: Po Pin Chau reservation trial held daily visitors to about 950 during National Day
en.dek: Environment secretary says the pilot scheme on the High Island Geo-Trail section successfully controlled numbers and improved order at the viewing platform.
body: Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan told the Legislative Council that a trial reservation system on the Po Pin Chau section of the High Island Geo-Trail kept average daily visitors to about 950 during the National Day Golden Week.

Tse said the pilot, which required real-name bookings via Klook for the 9am-to-5pm period on designated weekends and holidays between early September and early October, reduced peak crowds at the viewing platform by more than 30 percent compared with previous high-season days. Average daily entries to the East Dam area during the trial period were 1,760 people.

He reported that the system ran smoothly, site order was good, and public feedback was generally supportive, with most visitors finding the booking process simple. In contrast, the same section saw average daily visits of about 2,000 on ordinary days during the 2024 Lunar New Year and Labour Day peaks.

Tse emphasised that high-quality eco-tourism does not mean maximising visitor numbers, and that the reservation approach made carrying-capacity management more orderly. The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department is examining the trial results for possible longer-term arrangements.

zh.headline: 破邊洲預約制試行國慶期間日均到訪約950人
zh.dek: 環境及生態局局長表示，萬宜地質步道破邊洲段試行預約制有效控制人數，觀景台最高人流減逾三成。
body: 環境及生態局局長謝展寰回覆立法會質詢時表示，西貢萬宜水庫東壩的萬宜地質步道破邊洲段試行網上實名預約安排期間，國慶黃金周的日均到訪人數成功控制於約950人。
謝展寰指，與未試行預約制的高峰日子相比，預約制令破邊洲段觀景台最高人流減少逾三成，人流管理更為有序。試行期間每日進入東壩的平均人數為1,760人。
他表示，試行期間整體運作暢順，現場秩序良好，公眾與與論亦普遍支持有關措施，並認為預約流程簡單易用。2024年春節及勞動節黃金周期間，破邊洲段平日平均每日有約2,000人到訪。
謝展寰強調，高質素的生態旅遊並非「人數愈多愈好」，預約制令承載管理更有秩序。漁農自然護理署正研究試行結果，以考慮較長期的安排。
